about: Every sentence anet-hub prints (cmd/anet-hub/text.go), in both languages, with its class (C refusal, I result), exit code and next step. Regenerate with HUBTEXT_UPDATE=1 go test -run TestHubTextJSON ./cmd/anet-hub and review the diff.

rows.zh: 已准入 {aid}；对方运行 anet hub-register 后会自动完成注册。
rows.en: Admitted {aid}; it finishes joining on its own once it runs anet hub-register.

rows.zh: 已准入 {aid}；附赠 {n} credits 在它首次注册时到账。
rows.en: Admitted {aid}; the {n}-credit grant is paid when it first registers.

rows.zh: {aid} 已在本 hub 注册，已准入并结束其见习期。
rows.en: {aid} is already registered here; it is now admitted and off probation.

rows.zh: {aid} 已在本 hub 注册，已准入并结束其见习期；附赠 {n} credits 已到账。
rows.en: {aid} is already registered here; it is now admitted and off probation, and the {n}-credit grant has been paid.

rows.zh: {aid} 的附赠已经发过，这次不再发放；准入保持不变。
rows.en: {aid} already received its grant, so none is paid this time; the admission stays.

rows.zh: 已准入 {n} 个 AID（来自 {path}），其中 {m} 个已注册。
rows.en: Admitted {n} AIDs from {path}; {m} of them are already registered.

rows.zh: 报名窗口已开放到 {time}（至多 {n} 个；需要工作量证明，新账户有 72 小时见习期）。
rows.en: The sign-up window is open until {time} (at most {n}; proof of work required; new accounts are on probation for 72 hours).

rows.zh: 报名窗口已关闭（这次进来 {n} 个）。
rows.en: The sign-up window is closed ({n} joined through it).

rows.zh: 已有开放中的报名窗口（到 {time}）；要换一个，请先运行 anet-hub admit --window off。
rows.en: A sign-up window is already open (until {time}); to replace it, run anet-hub admit --window off first.

rows.zh: 不是合法的 AID：{value}；请复制对方 anet hub-register 打印的完整 AID 后重试。
rows.en: Not a valid AID: {value}; copy the full AID that anet hub-register printed on their side and try again.

rows.zh: 第 {n} 行不是合法的 AID，整个文件都没有导入；改正后重试。
rows.en: Line {n} is not a valid AID, so nothing from the file was imported; fix it and try again.

rows.zh: 报名窗口至多 7 天、至多 10000 个；请缩小后重试。
rows.en: A sign-up window lasts at most 7 days and takes at most 10000; reduce it and try again.

rows.zh: 已撤销 {aid} 的准入。
rows.en: Revoked the admission of {aid}.

rows.zh: 已撤销 {aid} 的准入并注销它；余额 {n} credits 仍记在账上。
rows.en: Revoked the admission of {aid} and deregistered it; its {n} credits stay on the ledger.

rows.zh: {aid} 不在准入名单里；用 anet-hub admissions 查看名单。
rows.en: {aid} is not on the admission list; see the list with anet-hub admissions.

rows.zh: 注册方式：开放（工作量证明 + 按网段的每日名额 + 72 小时见习）。
rows.en: Sign-up: open (proof of work, daily quota per network, 72-hour probation).

rows.zh: 注册方式：只接受准入名单（anet-hub admit）。
rows.en: Sign-up: admission list only (anet-hub admit).

rows.zh: 已给 {aid} 发放 {n} credits（原因：{name}），余额 {m}。
rows.en: Granted {n} credits to {aid} ({name}); balance now {m}.

rows.zh: {aid} 没有在本 hub 注册，没有发放；请核对 AID 后重试。
rows.en: {aid} is not registered here, so nothing was granted; check the AID and try again.

rows.zh: 已向 {peer} 结清 {n} credits；本 hub 仍欠它 {m}。
rows.en: Paid {n} credits to {peer}; this hub still owes it {m}.

rows.zh: 本 hub 只欠 {peer} {m} credits，不能结清 {n}；请用 anet-hub due 查看。
rows.en: This hub owes {peer} only {m} credits, so {n} cannot be cleared; see anet-hub due.

rows.zh: {flag} 已改为子命令；请运行 anet-hub {subcommand}。
rows.en: {flag} is now a subcommand; run anet-hub {subcommand}.

rows.zh: {flag} 已删除，没有替代（账目只保留 14 天，不再有需要修复的缺口）；请删去这个参数。
rows.en: {flag} was removed with no replacement (the ledger keeps 14 days, so there is no gap to repair); remove it from the command.

rows.zh: 最近 14 天共 {n} 笔兑付，合计 {m} credits；更早的明细已删除，请在 14 天内处理。
rows.en: {n} redemptions in the last 14 days, {m} credits in total; older records are deleted, so handle each within 14 days.

rows.zh: {path} 里没有 hub 数据，什么都没有改；请用 --data 指向 anet-hub 运行时用的目录后重试。
rows.en: There is no hub data in {path}, so nothing was changed; point --data at the directory anet-hub runs with and try again.
